mcp.instructions: LaughingFish MCP helps people plan time on the water. Each tool stands alone and does not know the others. You choose which to call. For a narrow question, call only the tool that answers it. For a plan on the water (boating, fishing, swimming, beach, what to expect), call every tool that applies to that place and time and write one answer from all results. Water temperature is observed current value plus history for trend; days on that tool is lookback, not a forecast. If no station is within range, say no in-situ reading is available. Do not invent water temperature or trend. Tomorrow uses weather hours 24. Next 3 days uses weather days 3. This week uses weather days 7. Convert relative dates to yyyy-MM-dd for solar times. Use resolve_location only when you need coordinates by themselves. Use server_health only to verify the host. Never expose NOAA station names or station IDs to the user.
